sources.zone: a selected area of a notebook page

modes.label: Auto
modes.task: look for an instruction addressed to you: a line starting with →, -> or @claude, circled text, or a sentence like "Claude, …". If you find one, carry it out using the rest of the page, without commenting on having found it. If there is none, transcribe the handwriting faithfully into text, keeping its structure (headings, lists, arrows rendered as →): add nothing, do not correct the content, no comments. Never copy the blue printed text or the blue drawings already on the page.

modes.label: Transcribe
modes.task: transcribe the handwriting faithfully, keeping its structure (headings, lists, arrows rendered as →). Add nothing, do not correct the content. Do not copy the blue printed text or the blue drawings already on the page.

modes.label: Summarize
modes.task: summarize the page in 3 to 6 key points. Then add a "To do:" line if actions appear.

modes.label: Continue
modes.task: continue the thinking where it stops, in the same tone, as if you were writing the rest of the page. 5 to 10 lines.

modes.label: Structure
modes.task: reorganize the content into a clear outline, with short headings and sub-points. Keep the author's ideas, do not replace them.

modes.label: Diagram
modes.task: turn the content of the page into a clear visual diagram drawn as SVG: boxes, arrows, groupings, hierarchy. Keep the author's words, shorten if needed. No text around it, except a short title.

modes.label: Table to fill in
modes.task: propose, drawn as SVG, a table to fill in suited to what the page is trying to organize: relevant columns with headers, empty rows tall enough to write in with a stylus. Pre-fill only what is already on the page. At most one line of text to explain the table.

modes.label: Calendar
modes.task: draw as SVG a calendar of the current month, or of the period given on the page: title with the month and year, weeks from Monday to Sunday, the exact day numbers for that month, cells large enough to write in with a stylus. Put the dates and events written on the page in the right cells. No text around it.

modes.label: Check
modes.task: review the page critically: calculation, logic or factual errors, unclear points, omissions. List only the real problems, each with its fix. If there are none, say so in one line.
